info.name: AutoVet API
info.description:
All AutoVet backend API routes, generated from `php artisan route:list`.

1. Pick an environment (AutoVet Local or AutoVet Live) and fill in `email` and `password`.
2. Run **Auth → POST /login**. It saves the token to the environment.
3. Every other request sends that token as a Bearer token automatically.

Example bodies come from each endpoint's validation rules. Replace the placeholder IDs and values with real ones.
